execute_vs_plan_property:
An EXECUTE-lane verdict has an operational consequence only if a named consumer actually enforces it; the lane label alone supplies no special validity.
Reader: a bound verdict can be read by a dispatcher/state-transition gate; a PLAN document may be read only by the assistant or a human unless a gate explicitly consumes it.
Independence: an EXECUTE verdict is not an independent acceptance verdict on its own work. A PLAN document written by the EXECUTE model adds no model independence; a separately dispatched PLAN turn can add process/context/lane separation, but retains correlated model blind spots. The current rank-1 PLAN and EXECUTE models differ.
Cost of being wrong: an enforced verdict can wrongly permit work or block completion, with concrete state consequences; an ungated planning document has no direct transition authority, though acting on bad advice can still be costly. Neither label guarantees correctness.
Receipt: a validated dispatcher receipt can establish the bound lane, required versus actually served provider/model, nonce, subject/output binding and recorded execution outcome, within its evidence ceiling. A document headed PLAN proves none of that.
A receipt does not prove reasoning correctness, substantive PASS, model independence, or canonical acceptance; EXECUTE cannot self-accept, and VERIFY_SECURITY remains the checker.
smallest_mechanism: Add one fail-closed PLAN-receipt precondition to the authoritative research-round completion transition, covering every path that can mark a round complete. Require a dispatcher-issued PLAN receipt bound to the same round ID, fresh nonce, frozen input/subject digest and PLAN output digest; validate its provenance against the dispatch record, the in-force route/mandate, and required_arm == served_arm (including any explicitly authorized fallback). Missing, malformed, stale, replayed, foreign-subject or mismatched receipts must reject the transition without changing state. A filename or a caller-supplied lane/model assertion is insufficient. Exercise the gate with a valid receipt and deterministic missing/mismatch/replay cases. This makes actual PLAN dispatch necessary for completion; it does not by itself establish plan quality or replace independent acceptance.
